basic_details.job_title: CSKHPKV Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: CSK Himachal Pradesh Krishi Vishvavidyalaya (CSKHPKV), Palampur, has invited applications for the post of Senior Research Fellow under Advt No. 09/2026. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 18 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Bank draft in favour of the Comptroller, CSKHPKV, Palampur. Last date to pay the fee: 18 November 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: M.Sc. in Plant Science + NET + experience in plant transformation as evident from publications; OR M.Sc. in Plant Science without NET + experience in plant transformation as evident from publications.
qualification.details: Qualification: M.Sc. in Plant Science + NET + experience in plant transformation as evident from publications; OR M.Sc. in Plant Science without NET + experience in plant transformation as evident from publications Experience: Experience in plant transformation as evident from publications

salary_details.pay_scale: With NET: Rs. 37,000 + HRA (1st and 2nd year), Rs. 42,000 + HRA (3rd year); without NET: Rs. 28,000 fixed per month

how_to_apply: Apply on plain paper; the application form, fee and terms notified vide no. QSD.9-54.CSKHPKV/Rectt/2015- 4750-4849 dated 30.01.2016 may be downloaded from www.hillagric.ac.in.
Enclose a bank draft for the processing (application) fee in favour of the Comptroller, CSKHPKV, Palampur.
Application must reach the office of The Head, Department of Agricultural Biotechnology, COA, CSKHPKV, Palampur H.P. by 18-11-2026 up to 05.00 P.M.
important_instructions: No separate communication will be made regarding the work specific interaction Project: Molecular genetic analysis of resistance/tolerance to different stresses in rice, wheat chickpea and mustard including sheath blight complex genomics (ICAR-223-57) Principal Investigator: Dr. Rajeev Rathour, Deptt. of Agricultural Biotechnology
